C1279.title: AI-Powered Plagiarism Ring Sentenced After Earning 270,000 Yuan Illegally
C1279.summary: In May 2024, an original illustrator discovered her artwork had been altered by AI and sold as puzzles. Police arrested several suspects, including Yao, Wang, and Li, while the ringleader Luo surrendered. The group stole 10 works from 6 creators, selling over 3,000 infringing puzzles within months and making more than 270,000 yuan in illegal profits. The court fined the infringing company 100,000
